conversations.name: Spring launch
conversations.description: Everything for the April release: copy, builds, press, and the party.

messages.text: Press kit is **done** 🎉 Screenshots, logo pack and the fact sheet are all in the shared folder.
Amazing. I'll send it to the three outlets tomorrow morning.
Thank you both — great work on this 🙌

Morning! Release candidate 3 is up on TestFlight. Changelog:

- Faster launch from the local cache
- Reactions show *who* reacted
- Fixed the unread badge getting stuck
Installing now 👀

messages.caption: Final icon, all sizes exported. Last chance for comments!

messages.text: That gradient is *so* good.
Are we still locked for **Tuesday 9:00** for the launch post?
Yes — Tuesday 9:00 it is. @sofia can you schedule the newsletter for 9:15?
On it 📬 Draft is here: https://nextcloud.com/talk/
One more thing before we ship — the release notes still mention the old keyboard shortcut. Fixing now.
Ramen it is then 🍜 I'll book a table for eight.
Perfect. See you all there!
Do you have the latest numbers for the beta sign-ups?
2,340 as of this morning — up 18% on last week 📈
That's brilliant. Let's put it in the launch post.
Newsletter is scheduled for Tuesday 9:15 ✅
Want to grab a coffee before the all-hands?

conversations.name: Design crit
conversations.description: Share work in progress. Be kind, be specific.

messages.text: Weekly crit is at 15:00 — drop anything you want eyes on in here first.

messages.caption: Onboarding, take two. Fewer steps, bigger type.

messages.text: Much calmer than v1. Could the second screen lose the illustration?
New sidebar spacing is in the Figma file — tighter rows, same tap targets.
Looks great on the 13" too.
@freja could you take a look at the empty states before 3? 🙏
I'll bring snacks 🥐
The journalist from the tech podcast wants a 20-minute call next week.
Happy to! Wednesday afternoon works best for me.
Booked for Wednesday 14:00 👍
Thanks for sorting the press list, by the way.
Any time 🙂
Heads up: the build machine gets its update tonight, so expect CI to be slow for an hour.
Found the scrolling hitch. We were re-measuring every row on each new message:
Ha, nice catch! That explains the stutter on long threads.
RC3 is signed and uploaded. Crash-free sessions at **99.8%** 🎯
Ship it! 🚢
Who's in for Friday lunch? 🥗
Me!
Count me in
Yes please — somewhere with outdoor seating?
Outdoor seating it is ☀️
Love the warm tones. Let's go with this direction.
Next month: *The Left Hand of Darkness*. Discussion on the 28th.
Finally! I've wanted to read it for years.
